benchmark: constrained QED editing, Jin et al. ICLR-2019 panel; GrIDDD (Ninniri et al., NeurIPS 2025) reports the comparator number on its own panel

panel.note: sha256 prefix only; the runner re-verifies the full digest at load

slots.why_two_numbers: whole_ring_plan.execute_program requires graph.n_atoms == 48 (allocated array width) AND 1 <= graph.n_real_atoms <= 40 (active heavy-atom ceiling). PRODUCTION_MAX_ATOMS = 40 is the ACTIVE ceiling and is not the padding width; padding to 40 slots fails closed.

support_policy.reward: QED, unmodified, on the admitted set only
support_policy.qed_target_is_not_an_admission_gate: output feasibility (success) is evaluated on returned endpoints; intermediate program states and proposed endpoints are NOT required to satisfy the QED target
support_policy.rationale: FiberControl shape: feasibility constrains the support, reward ranks inside it. Putting the similarity indicator in the reward spends budget on zero-scored molecules.

excluded_inherited_gates: sa_max = 4.0 (src/compose_v4/control/program_task.py:77) -- synthetic accessibility is not part of this benchmark
qed_min = 0.6 (src/compose_v4/control/program_task.py:76) -- a second, lower QED floor that would also make a contract qed_target field decorative
compose_v4.gates.med_chem_gate.is_valid via t4_endpoint_selection.acceptable_endpoint -- an inherited medicinal-chemistry heuristic, not a benchmark threshold

authorization.reason: QED and Morgan-Tanimoto are local RDKit computations; this benchmark has no paid oracle
